raw_sections.experience:
ServiceNow Developer
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
ServiceNow Developer | Consultiquo (Endow Consultants Pvt. Ltd.) | Sep 2025 – Present Client: PepsiCo | On-site
Now Assist & AI Agent Validation: Implemented and validated Now Assist AI features to enhance self-service and agent productivity within ITSM. Conducted structured testing to ensure accuracy and collaborated with leadership to align AI adoption roadmaps.
Service Catalog Development: Architected the 'Modify Group Membership' catalog item and complex workflow automation to streamline access management, reducing manual IT overhead and improving resolution times.
Reporting & Dashboard Leadership: Led the end-to-end design of ServiceNow dashboards for PepsiCo stakeholders. Built

real-time trackers for SLA compliance, incident trends, and IT team workload distribution. Integration Expertise & Scalable Solution Design: Configured Integration Hub spokes and REST APIs for external systems, including Microsoft Teams, to ensure real-time data synchronization and scalable enterprise notifications.
Platform Performance Optimization: Spearheaded automated regression testing using Automated Test Framework (ATF) during the Zurich upgrade, ensuring high-performance ITSM workflows and platform stability.
ServiceNow Developer | Tata Consultancy Services (TCS) | Mar 2022 – Aug 2025

Flow Designer & Inbound Actions: Designed inbound email actions via Flow Designer to trigger automatic incident creation. Configured keyword extraction to auto-populate fields from email subjects and bodies.
Virtual Agent Implementation: Designed conversational flows to surface common solutions and deflect tickets. Enabled fallback

ticket creation and real-time status tracking, heavily reducing live agent workload. ITSM & Service Catalog Development: Maintained catalog items, workflows, and record producers. Configured UI policies/actions and customized the Incident, Problem, and Change Management modules.
Agile Delivery: Resolved Jira stories/tasks promptly and collaborated with cross-functional teams to gather requirements and deploy technical solutions.
